maxBreaths.title: Maximum micro-breaths this pulse
maxBreaths.description: Maximum safe internal transitions in this pulse. The Kernel may traverse up to 12 deterministic/free micro-breaths, while the costly frontier remains capped at one per run.

observation.title: Optional Fruit observation
observation.description: Machine-provided sensor snapshot. Metric-only churn is stored quietly; only decision-relevant truth changes create a Garden event and wake Flower.
